preconditions.description: Grid dimensions n and m are within bounds 1 to 50.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all(len(line) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Input consists of n+1 lines: first line with n and m, followed by n lines of m characters each.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'.', '#'} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each character in the grid is either '.' (unpainted) or '#' (painted).

preconditions.expression: any(c == '#' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line)
preconditions.description: At least one square in the grid is painted (set A is non-empty).
The set of painted squares A is connected (as defined in the task).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (stdout.strip().isdigit() and 0 <= int(stdout.strip()) <= len([c for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line if c == '#']))
postconditions.description: Output is either -1 (impossible to disconnect) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of squares to delete to disconnect A.

postconditions.expression: min_deletions := int(stdout.strip()) if stdout.strip().isdigit() else -1; min_deletions == -1 or (min_deletions == 0 and not is_connected(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If output is 0, the set A is already disconnected (impossible case, but handled for completeness).

postconditions.expression: min_deletions := int(stdout.strip()) if stdout.strip().isdigit() else -1; min_deletions != -1 and all(not is_connected(delete_squares(grid, deleted)) for deleted in find_min_deletions(grid) if len(deleted) == min_deletions)
postconditions.description: If output is a non-negative integer k, there exists a set of k squares whose deletion disconnects A, and no smaller set exists.

postconditions.expression: min_deletions := int(stdout.strip()) if stdout.strip().isdigit() else -1; min_deletions == -1 or (min_deletions == 0 and not is_connected(stdin.splitlines()[1:])) or (min_deletions > 0 and is_connected(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If output is -1, the set A cannot be disconnected by deleting any number of squares (i.e., it is a single square or a trivial case).
